thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a small CSops project to normalize healthscore inputs and migrate playbook triggers to the new schema. Goal: fewer false-risk flags and consistent onboarding states. Hoping to get a quick sync today. :wave:

Derek: awesome. can you outline the main pain points you're seeing?

maria: main issues — inconsistent 'last_active' vs telemetry TTL, duplicate account merges double-counting usage, and playbooks that trigger on old event names (e.g., `trial_started_v1`). Also some manual overrides bypassed our gating rules.

anita: +1. we've had several renewals flagged incorrectly because their primary contact was soft-deleted in the CRM. I can share a list of ~40 accounts that showed up last month.

josh: tagging in ops-bot: can you surface recent playbook runs where healthscore changed >20 pts within 24h?

ops-bot: @josh here are the last 48h runs with >20pt delta (id, acct, delta):
- 4521, acme-inc, 23
- 4590, blue-rail, 25
- 4602, greenlane, 31

maria: thanks. plan proposal: 1) canonicalize activity windows to use telemetry.signal_timestamp with TTL=30d default, 2) dedupe merged accounts at scoring layer (prefer canonical account id), 3) map old event names to new ones via transform table, 4) update playbook triggers and add canary rule.

Derek: timeline? I can block a few hours tomorrow to help with SQL and playbook config.

maria: aiming for a dry-run in staging by Thursday and rollout Mon next week if no regressions.

anita: for the dedupe rules — can you include a fallback so manual merges still keep owner history? last time we lost owner tags and it caused manual handoffs to fail.

maria: yes — dedupe will keep owner history in `owner_history` array and prefer non-null owner when scoring. Example mapping snippet I'll use in the transformer:```sql
-- map legacy events
SELECT acct_id, CASE
  WHEN event_name IN ('trial_started_v1','trial_init') THEN 'trial_start'
  WHEN event_name IN ('onboard_step_completed_v2') THEN 'onboard_checkpoint'
  ELSE event_name
END AS canonical_event, event_ts
FROM raw_events
WHERE event_ts > now() - interval '90 days';
```

josh: looks good. For playbooks canary: can we route 5% of traffic to the new trigger set and keep a realtime regression monitor (tokens/per-hour, avg healthscore, and renewal risk false positives)?

maria: yep. plan to add a canary flag and use the existing playbook router. Canary metrics we want: false_positive_rate (manual overrides / triggered), median time-to-first-action, and ops/CS escalations.

anita: please add a quick CSV export of accounts affected in staging run so enablement can sanity-check before prod.

maria: will do. action items I have so far:
- maria: implement transformer and draft SQL mapping (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- derek: help with test queries and staging config (ETA: tomorrow noon)
- anita: provide list of soft-deleted contacts & sample accounts (ETA: today afternoon)
- josh: set up canary routing + dashboards (ETA: Wed)

Derek: I'm saving the SQL snippet and will add unit tests for the dedupe behavior. Quick question — do we want to treat imported historical merges as instantaneous or respect the merge timestamp?

maria: respect merge timestamp — that preserves historical health trends. We'll only apply canonicalization for scoring windows that start after merge_ts.

ops-bot: deployment note: there's a scheduled config deploy Fri 22:00 UTC. Avoid colliding changes or ping infra to reserve window.

josh: good catch. I'll coordinate with infra and reserve a small maintenance window during canary ramp.

anita: once we have the staging CSV, I'll run a few enablement checks (contact sanity, renewal owner present, onboarding steps). If anything looks off I'll flag in this thread.

maria: thanks all — I'll post the first staging run results here and attach the CSV. For now, quick ack pls if you're aligned with the plan. :pray:

Derek: ack

anita: ack

josh: ack

ops-bot: reminder scheduled standup in 20m.
